# CWN linked-SRD page audit (#950)

Per page of the linked SRD. The system-level view - what a system is and how far it is ported - is `docs/rules/MUD_CWN_COMPLIANCE.md`; this file answers the different question of whether any page has been left out.

**Generated by `tools/cwn_page_audit.py --render`; do not edit by hand.** `tests/test_cwn_srd_page_audit_950.py` fails if this file and the repository disagree.

**Correction.** The first version of this audit resolved Python only in `mud/nopunk_mud/cwn_core.py` and reported 68 pages missing. The rules layer in `src/rules/cwn_*.py` already implemented most of them, so that figure measured one file, not the project. It now resolves every module named in `python_globs`, and a symbol only counts when it is really declared.

Scope: the **82 pages** of the linked SRD at <https://cwn.quadrifons.com/>. This is not coverage of the published *Cities Without Number* book: the hosted SRD omits Antagonists/NPCs and some optional rules, and those pages are absent from the source rather than marked complete.

| Coverage | Pages |
|---|---:|
| implemented | 36 |
| partial | 17 |
| missing | 24 |
| n/a | 5 |
| **total** | **82** |

A page is `implemented` only when a test exercises it. `partial` means some of the page is ported and the rest is named in the note. `n/a` is a landing or terminology page with no procedure of its own, and always carries a reason.

## NoöPunk overlays

No page carries a NoöPunk overlay yet. Noösphere, Psyche, faction reputation and GUMSHOE-style investigation are **mods on this core** and must not change a CWN number; when one is added it gets its own column entry here rather than being folded into CWN coverage.

## Porting order

The solo campaign in #950 needs, in this order: skills and backgrounds, initiative and action economy, Shock, injuries and healing, encumbrance, weapons and armour, then hacking. That is everything currently marked `missing` in `character-creation` and the combat rows.
